PC: CAB assessment: check carotid pulse, look for respiratory effort
Request cardiac monitor and pulse ox, check blood pressure
Attach Ambu bag to oxygen, set at 10-15L
Open airway using chin lift and initiate single-person BVM (will not work)
Open airway using jaw thrust and initiate two-person BVM (will not work initially but will work once oral airway are inserted)
Place oropharyngeal airway (will not work alone but will work in combination with jaw thrust and two-person BVM technique, causing pulse ox to increase and patient to stabilize)
SBP: Call for help – learners must request either code team or rapid response team
